items.statement: Operating cash flow for FY25 was INR 368 crores, representing 81% conversion to EBITDA, adjusted to 74% excluding a tax refund.
items.quote: Our operating cash flow for the year is INR 368 crores, representing a healthy 81% conversion to EBITDA. I must highlight that we also had a tax refund during this quarter for one of our subsidiaries. And adjusted for that, our OCF to EBITDA will be 74% for the year.

items.statement: Raised INR130.7 crores through fundraise with promoter participation

items.quote: The group has a robust cash reserves at INR172 crores in bank and mutual funds, thus being adequately funded.

items.statement: Digital app cash burn reduced to INR35 lakhs per month from INR120-145 crores annually two years ago
items.quote: And currently, I will just say the cash burn which was close to INR120 crores to INR145 crores till say two years back. Now the cash burn is around INR35 lakhs each month.

items.statement: Receivables nearly doubled due to extended credit terms for a legacy client to 45 days and new customers on higher credit terms; targeting 50-55 days cash conversion cycle
items.quote: So on the receivables part, you are right the receivables have doubled, almost doubled. So the reason behind this is there are two reasons. One is that we had to extend the credit terms for key existing customers from the existing terms to 45 days in order to support the revenue generation.

items.statement: Receivables increased due to extended credit terms for a legacy client to 45 days and new customer onboarding on higher credit terms; targeting 50-55 days cash conversion cycle
items.quote: One is that we had to extend the credit terms for one of our legacy clients to 45 days to support the revenue transition. And the second is the new customer onboarding that we have done in the second half of FY '24 and in FY '25.

items.statement: AGM on July 26th for shareholder approval of business transfer as material related party transaction
items.quote: We are holding an AGM on July 26th to get shareholder approval of the business transfer, since it's a material related party transaction.

items.statement: Bulk of transaction money expected by August; small holdback with long-stop date October 1, 2025
items.quote: Now, the bulk of the transaction money should be coming in by August. There is a small holdback, which could come in after some time, and the long-stop date is October 1st, 2025.

items.statement: No need to raise further capital; deal proceeds sufficient for growth to INR500 crores target
items.quote: But we don't see any need for raising more money at this point of time. Our sense is whatever we are getting through this deal should stand us in good stead as we look at growing to our next target.

items.statement: No further equity raise planned; growth funded from deal proceeds non-dilutively
items.quote: We don't see any need for raising more money at this point of time. Our sense is whatever we are getting through this deal should stand us in good stead as we look at growing to our next target.

items.statement: Cash and equity balance is approximately Rs 1,400 crore, of which Rs 500 crore belongs to the company and Rs 800-900 crore belongs to clients.
items.quote: Approximately cash and equity balance where you can see approximately 1400 crores, which consist of 500 crores are ours and rest of the INR 800 to 900 crores are the clients.

items.statement: Outgoing CFO Amit Gala decided to move on; Bhavik Khara takes over as CFO
items.quote: Our outgoing CFO, Amit Gala, has decided to move on from Aris Infra. We thank him for his contributions during a crucial phase of our journey, particularly in supporting the IPO process.

items.statement: Net working capital cycle improved from 120 days in FY24 to 110 days in FY25
items.quote: Our overall net working capital cycle improved from 120 days in FY24 to 110 days in FY25, driven by stronger collections, tighter vendor alignment and more disciplined credit management.

items.statement: Recovered INR3-5 crores from stock receivables in July; monthly recovery target in that range
items.quote: Yes, yes, I think we've close to recovered about INR3 crores to INR5 crores from the stock receivables in the month of July. And that's been the target historically as well.

items.statement: Total cash and bank balance including FDs about INR120-130 crores as of March 2025
items.quote: Yes, so it's going to be -- the FDs are in the range of INR69 crores to INR72 crores and INR45 crores of cash in cash balances, which is a function of the pre -IPO that we did in Jan and Feb. So the total is going to be about INR120 crores to 130 crores.

items.statement: Raised INR580 crores gross via IPO and pre-IPO at same pricing; all primary issuance
items.quote: Yes. So the total value that we've raised is INR580 crores and the pricing for both was same. That is correct. Yes.

items.statement: Investor Global sold about 40% of its holding after buying at INR38 and seeing the price reach INR100-odd.
items.quote: They have purchased the share at INR38, invested global. They have sold, I think, about 40% of their portfolio. 40% of the holding because they got about INR100-odd rupees.

items.statement: Management has no plans for further equity dilution as of now; the previous preferential issue was to cross INR75 crores net worth for NSE listing eligibility in FY27.
items.quote: No, no. We don't have any plans of further dilution as of now. The main reason for raising for INR75 crores CR equity in the last year was to get eligible for NSE listing.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow is considered good as it indicates higher disbursements; the company views cash flow as a measure of money deployed into the market.
items.quote: For us, having a negative cash flow is actually good. It means we are disbursing more money. For us, operating cash flow means how much are we disbursing.

items.statement: Two rounds of preferential warrants raised INR174.87 crore equity, INR161.22 crore infused; INR13 crore pending conversion over next three quarters
items.quote: We successfully raised a total equity of INR174.87 crores, out of which INR161.22 crores has been infused into the company. This race was concluded in two strategic rounds of preferential warrants.

items.statement: Approximately INR13 crore pending from warrant conversion, expected in coming three quarters
items.quote: Only an amount which is approximately INR13 crore s is pending to be received against the warrant conversion. It should be received in the coming three quarters

items.statement: Rights issue at Andhra Cements to reduce promoter holding from 90% to 75% for minimum shareholding compliance, targeting Dasara timeframe subject to market conditions
items.quote: Because of the minimum shareholding compliance, yeah, we need to reduce from current 90% of Sagar Cements Holding to 75%. So I think the price of the market will decide how much we will raise, but our idea is to reduce from 90% to 75% holding.

items.statement: SEBI clearance obtained for rights issue at Andhra Cements, approval valid until December, team working towards Dasara timeframe
items.quote: So we do have clearance from SEBI and the approval is all the way up to December. So the team is working towards somewhere around Dasara time for us to hit the rights thing, but these are all subject to market conditions.

items.statement: Cash and bank balances were ₹182 crores as on 30th June 2025
items.quote: Cash and bank balances were at ₹182 crores as on 30th June 2025.

items.statement: Additional ₹12 crore incentive pending for current year, expected anytime in Q2 or Q3
items.quote: Yeah, there is an additional ₹12 crore that is likely to happen. That is the only pending incentive available for the current year.

items.quote: I think out of ₹46 crore, we did receive ₹34 crores, sir. Another ₹12 crore is due, which we are expecting in current or maybe by middle of next quarter.

items.quote: We have utilized around Rs. 71 crores of funds, which were raised till 30th June. And most of them is used in working capital and around Rs. 19 crores is used in the CAPEX.

This fund raise is a significant as it includes both promoter inclusion and participation from marquee public investors, including our first major domestic institutional investor.
